description: Plan a weekend in Tokyo on Google Flights and Google Maps in background tabs; book nothing.
prompt: I'm planning a long weekend in Tokyo. In background tabs, find the cheapest nonstop round trip from Seoul to Tokyo on Google Flights for Nov 20 to 23, and on Google Maps, plan a day route through Senso-ji, Tokyo Skytree and Ueno Park by public transit. Don't book anything. Give me the flight and the order of stops with travel times.
